entities.summary: Soviet, a notable figure in the history of Kyrgyzstan, associated with Soviet Kyrgyzstan (1917–1936). Preceded by Basmachi Resistance and National Delimitation. Their legacy influenced Soviet national delimitation creates the Kara-Kyrgyz Autonomous Oblast and Kyrgyz SSR established as a full Soviet republic.
